facts.fact: Mission head Ronsard Malonda said the legal framework covers the establishment of the computerized electoral list, and that the electoral file is extracted from the RNPP and FNEC registers.
The experts said the provisional electoral list is being displayed and an upcoming consultation will let voters verify their information, make claims and correct data.

The experts said the Electoral File is extracted from the National Register of Physical Persons (RNPP) and the National Civil State File (FNEC), with duplicates eliminated upstream in the civil status file.

facts.fact: The experts said the Electoral File is extracted from the RNPP and FNEC registers, and that a unique identifier per citizen underlies the civil status file.
The experts said Benin, thanks to a unique identifier per citizen, has an overhauled civil status file, with RAVIP tablets still in use at town halls and ANIP services deployed locally.

facts.fact: The document names the RNPP, the National Register of Physical Persons, as one of three main registers fed by data collected in municipalities.
The experts said birth declarations are systematized and changes of residence and identification data are integrated through ANIP services in town halls.
